name: Add markdown viewer to file viewer
description:
# Summary

FileViewer component was enhanced to support markdown file preview using the MarkdownViewer component. Three markdown file extensions (`.md`, `.markdown`, `.mermaid`) are now detected and rendered with a dedicated markdown viewer instead of code highlighting. The implementation includes a new `isMarkdown` computed property and event handlers to proxy `add-file` and `table-updated` events from the MarkdownViewer component. The changes maintain backward compatibility with existing file viewing functionality for PDFs, images, videos, and code files.
